mechanism: Albendazole may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing tetrabenazine plasma concentrations and risk of adverse effects including QT prolongation and hepatotoxicity.
action: Monitor for tetrabenazine toxicity (akathisia, parkinsonism, QT prolongation); consider dose reduction of tetrabenazine or alternative anthelmintic if coadministration necessary; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
